title.en: Watashi wo Dekiaishi Sugiru Danna-sama wa Konya mo Furete Kuremasen
Kokoro wo Tozashita Koushaku Kakka to Konyaku Shita Hazu na no ni, Naze ka Taisetsu ni Sasete Shimattemasu!
Kouri no Koushaku-sama to Karisome no Hanayome - Kozukuri Shitara Rikon no Hazu ga, Naze ka Chouaisaretemasu
"Raise de Kekkon shite kuremasu ka" to Chikatta Buka ga, Gense de wa Toshiue no Kishi Danchou-sama ni Natte Ite, Hontou ni Kekkon wo Semararete Iru Ken
Fukigen na Koushaku-sama wa Uso Hakkenki Tsuki Reijou no Torisetsu wo Goshomou desu
Bad End Kakutei no Seiryaku Kekkon ni Tsukawareta Mob Hakushaku Reijou, Tensei Chishiki Mochi no Moto Kuzu Danna-sama to Kono Sekai wo Sukuimasu
Amai Okashi no Nochi wa Amai Dekiai wo - Konyaku Hakisareta Reijou wa Henkyou Haku Shisoku ni Dekiaisareru
Kenka Bakari Datta Konyakusha ga Ikinari Dekiai shitekimasu
Hyakunen no Tsumadoi - Umarekawatte mo Anata ni Totsugimasu
Fuguu no Reijou wa Kitai no Hikari Mahoutsukai ni Misomerare Hanahiraku
Hanayome Shuugyou wo Yametakute, Reitetsu Koushaku no 13-banme no Konyakusha ni narimasu
"Kuji" kara Hajimaru Konyaku Seikatsu ~Gensei naru Chuusen no Kekka, Warawanai Jiki Koushaku-sama no Konyakusha ni Tousen shimashita~
Dokushin Shugi no Reijou wa, Koushaku-sama no Dekiai kara Nogaretai
Waru Nadakaki Reikoku Ouji wa Watashi no Koto Shika Aisenai
Akujo no Watashi wo Shokei shita Kishi Danchou ni, Naze ka Dekiaisaretemasu
